response.description: Fungal infection causing brown lesions on leaves, spreading fastest in humid conditions.
response.remedy: ಶಿಲೀಂಧ್ರನಾಶಕ (ತಾಮ್ರ ಆಧಾರಿತ) ಸಿಂಪಡಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸೋಂಕಿತ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಹಾಕಿ.
prevention_tips: Avoid overhead irrigation late in the day
Ensure adequate spacing between plants for airflow
Remove and destroy infected plant debris after harvest
